chain.decision: Author a prototype or attach a runtime handler.

findings.title: Recycling is a lossy authored reverse process with exceptions

evidence.limit: Saved JSON is version pinned; latest HTML URL can move.
Saved JSON is version pinned; latest HTML URL can move.

chain.decision: Salvage rejected or unwanted outputs for inputs or dispose of an item.
chain.prerequisites: A permitted authored reverse recipe and recycling machinery.
chain.expenditure: The consumed finished item, power/time and material loss.
chain.mutation: Generator maps eligible single-item fixed results back to item ingredients at a quarter yield; fluid ingredients are not returned as fluids. Fractional count handling and self-recycling are explicit.
chain.downstream_consumer: New manufacturing inputs, quality sorting and waste removal.
chain.time_policy: Installed generated reverse work is original recipe energy_required (default0.5)/16. Experimental divides further by result count and floors positive work; not installed behavior.
chain.failure: Installed default generation excludes explicit auto_recycle=false and many process categories/material exceptions listed in installed_reconciliation. Separate self-recycling remains. Fluid ingredients are not reconstructed as fluid outputs.
chain.aftermath: Productivity is capped by recipe maximum_productivity default 3; a salvage loop cannot be assumed to conserve all inputs.

findings.original_yair_implication: Author one original salvage contract with conserved custody, explicit lost material and a known useful return. Never automatically invert every YAIR recipe or refund the complete bill of materials after its product was used.
findings.review_bounds: Full reverse-generation script semantically reviewed; artwork helpers are incidental. No native random sampling or full module-combination optimization.

chain.decision: Consume freshest supplies, use older supplies first, cultivate or discard a risky biological item.
chain.prerequisites: An actually owned lot, supported spoil clock and explicit recipe freshness rules.

chain.mutation: Installed item expiry produces another item or trigger. Recipe-level result_is_always_fresh and reset_freshness_on_craft are explicit exceptions; no experimental spoil_weight field is attributed to installed stable.

chain.aftermath: Freshness remains meaningful after movement or processing; expiry can make a useful byproduct or a hazard rather than simply delete value.

findings.title: Regional production can reverse the normal resource order

chain.decision: Build around locally abundant resources and import a scarce enabling material.
chain.prerequisites: Local lava/calcite and metallurgy on one route; scrap, magnetic-field and lightning support on another.
chain.expenditure: Catalyst-like enabling material is still actually consumed; processing power, storage and handling matter.
chain.mutation: Molten metal has stone byproducts and can cast ordinary plates; scrap yields intermediates upstream of their normal manufactured ingredients.
chain.downstream_consumer: Infrastructure/material use, holmium processing and electronic machinery.
chain.time_policy: Machine speed and work duration constrain conversion; lightning uses defined capture efficiency and stored energy.
chain.failure: Surplus coproducts and finite space become a production problem. Imported know-how does not provide the local material or a qualifying environment.
chain.aftermath: A regional process produces equipment useful elsewhere while preserving a regional reason to revisit.

findings.original_yair_implication: A distinct YAIR region could make worked salvage plentiful but raw ore scarce, or provide abundant rough material requiring a portable rare flux. Connect gathering, refining, waste and downstream construction, rather than rename the same ore ladder.
findings.review_bounds: Selected Vulcanus/Fulgora production and energy fields. Full resources/map generation, territorial combat and all recipes are unreviewed.

chain.decision: Predict yield, choose a process or plan storage for uncertain results.
chain.expenditure: Each committed input is real even if no desired result appears.
chain.mutation: Installed scrap has per-product probability values. Stable API describes zero-or-count output and expected value; experimental shared_probability intervals are a separate later contract.
chain.downstream_consumer: Stock planning, desired holmium acquisition, sorting and later production.
chain.time_policy: Rolls occur on actual product attempts, not from an average displayed as guaranteed output.
chain.failure: Actual desired product can be absent from a finite paid attempt. Experimental disjoint shared-roll intervals and their0.40 no-match range are not installed stable behavior.
chain.aftermath: A finite batch has realized outcomes and retained cause; changing a formula or reloading must not replace it with expected yield.

findings.original_yair_implication: If an original salvage/assay is uncertain, freeze one realized outcome when the job contract requires it, report its cause, and let storage/stock plans consume actual results.
